study.question: Can a third-moment correction of collision entropy recover the observed Shannon utility gap while retaining lower measured cost at the direct_lifted utility level?
study.hypothesis: Observed: full H2 replacement g2-r0028-collision_sparse AUC0.6301493507 versus matched Shannon g2-r0028-exact_sparse0.6304873868 (delta -0.0003380361), train604.477/628.096s and inference21.4515/22.1598s. These single-seed timings and utilities are provisional. H2=-log(C), C=sum(p^2), cannot distinguish (3,3)/6 from (4,1,1)/6 although their Shannon entropies differ by0.174416. Hypothesis: skewness information discarded by H2 partly explains utility loss. With T=sum(p^3), a second-order expansion of -E_size-biased[log p] around E_size-biased[p]=C gives Hcorr=H2+0.5*(T/C^2-1), clipped to [H2,log(n)] for integer sample mass n>=1; empty cells return0. This is a heuristic approximation, not an entropy bound or guaranteed error improvement. It adds information at identical learned capacity; cubes may erase the cost advantage.

Utility retention is predeclared as candidate-minus-current Shannon AUC>=-0.00030 AND logloss<=control+0.00010. Also require AUC>=0.6301316803980214 and logloss<=0.19279404064402526 relative to frozen g1-r0020-direct_lifted. Fixed-reference gates are contextual, not paired statistical evidence.

Efficiency target: at least3% reduction in host training seconds or full validation inference seconds versus sparse Shannon, at retained utility; report both costs and p50/p95, parameter counts and peak memory. Require consistent sign on at least two paired seeds before calling savings reproducible; otherwise exploratory only.
Current model has17253123 allocated parameters and174435 dense parameters; candidate and byte-identical Shannon control retain these exactly. Allocation is not an active-capacity proof.
falsifiers: Count/nonentropy or independent third-moment oracle errors>2e-6, nonfinite logits, unexpected parameter/config differences, padding/order dependence of recurrence, or invalid-source imports fail integrity gates before interpreting AUC.
Failure of either prespecified AUC/logloss margin rejects utility retention for this implementation, regardless of cost; no margin relaxation after results.
No reproducible>=3% training or inference reduction rejects the efficiency claim even with utility retention. Faster but less accurate is a tradeoff, not retention.
No AUC recovery over g2-r0028-collision_sparse leaves the third-moment explanation unsupported. One failed correction does not refute the value of higher moments or Shannon information.
alternative_explanations: Seed/checkpoint selection, GPU/host timing noise, floating reduction order and adaptive validation selection may explain differences. Existing controls use seed42 but separate receipts, not independent mechanism replications.

Third moment modifies feature scaling and redundancy as well as distribution information; fixed-capacity replacement cannot separate those effects. Clipping can saturate or amplify noise, and Taylor expansion can be inaccurate for skewed distributions.

Previous action-context coarsening (0.6297515 vs shared_full0.6307423) and rank8 replacement (0.6296234 vs full0.6304134) lost utility; neither proves the cause of entropy replacement failure. Concentration overlap replacement was not better than zero overlap. No original failed executions are listed; these are scientifically unsuccessful/null trajectories, not execution failures.
